turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
LETS GOOO!! 🎉 That's huge, congrats!! How long have you been working toward this one?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.
14 months and you pushed through!! That makes it SO much sweeter. Imagine if you'd walked away two weeks ago 😅 You need to celebrate tonight, this is a big deal!
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That genuinely means a lot, thank you for sharing it with me first. But go enjoy that dinner - watching her reaction is going to be a moment you'll never forget. 🥂

You did the hard part. You held on when it made no sense to. That's all you.
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Both, honestly. Take tonight and maybe tomorrow to actually feel this - you earned it. Then get back to it.

A week off right now might mess with your momentum and you'd probably just be anxious the whole time anyway. But if you don't pause at ALL you'll burn out and resent the work.

One good dinner, maybe a weekend. Then execute. 🤝
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

There's always another one. That's just the truth.

But that doesn't mean this one doesn't matter - it absolutely does. This is a real milestone, not just a stepping stone. Let yourself feel it fully tonight.

The hunger coming back after? That's not a curse, that's just who you are. It's probably why you didn't fold two weeks ago.
